blocks.covariance: block diagonal sigma_j^2 I with each sigma_j>0
blocks.means: the two adopted C01 tuples; only slope block changes

controls: H=0 gives coincident means and KL=0
exclusions: no equality of compressed probability laws
no measure-theoretic Gaussian theorem beyond stated finite KL algebra
targets: block rotation identity on unchanged blocks and R on slope block is orthogonal
all five mean block norms agree between tuples
for common block covariance Sigma, KL(N(mu1,Sigma)||N(mu2,Sigma))=(1/2)(mu1-mu2)^T Sigma^-1(mu1-mu2)=225H^2/(64 sigma_p^2)
